exposure: de novo heterozygous pathogenic TLK2 variants
cohort: Two children with global developmental delay were studied, both found to have de novo heterozygous pathogenic TLK2 variants.
finding: The study identified a novel TLK2 variant (c.6del p.(Glu3Lysfs*)) and previously undescribed features, expanding the clinical phenotype and providing further genotype-phenotype correlation for TLK2-related neurodevelopmental disorder.
